name: ME2 Melbourne

address.note: Equinix ME2 page (source 5) gives '578 Lorimer Street'; City of Melbourne list gives 600 Lorimer St for ME1/ME2 (source 10)

lat.note: geocoded: centroid of OSM building "Equinix ME2" (OSM address 522-578 Lorimer St vs 552-578 in sources)

mw_it.note: not published by Equinix; aggregators give 3 MW ('Total power 3000 kW', 3 kW per cabinet — inflect, source 11; datacentermap 2-3 MW, source 6) — unverified; ~3,000 cabinets at full build after phase 3 (source 9)

cost_aud_m.note: Equinix opening release (24 Feb 2020): US$77.5m (approx A$116m); announcement coverage (ARN, 12 Mar 2019) gave A$117m (US$84m). Phase 2 added A$23m (completed Aug 2022, source 8); phase 3 is part of an A$240m Sydney+Melbourne investment (June 2024, source 9) with no ME2 split

authority.note: inferred from ministerial ref PA1600153 / TPM prefix; tracker labels pathway 'Ministerial fast-track'

pathway.note: tracker label 'Ministerial fast-track'; inferred from PA ref

reference.note: City of Melbourne data-centre list entry for 'Equinix ME1/ME2' (600 Lorimer St) lists permits TP-2012-1007, TP-2012-1007/A, TPM-2016-26, TPM-2016-26/A and ministerial ref PA1600153; attribution of the 2016 ministerial permit to ME2 (opened 2020) is inferred, not stated

construction_end.note: phase 1 opened: Equinix release dated 24 Feb 2020 (source 1, verified), IT Brief 27 Feb 2020; phase 2 (+500 cabinets to 1,500) completed Aug 2022 (source 8); phase 3 (+1,500 cabinets to ~3,000) expected Q3 2024 (source 9)

open_questions: scope: MW not published; aggregators suggest ~3 MW (< 5 MW threshold) — likely out of scope
